d: In this video, Firstpost explains the dramatic rescue of a Russian paraglider who became trapped in high-voltage power lines nearly 200 feet above the ground in Himachal Pradesh's Mandi district. Identified as Aleksei Ivakhin, he was stranded for nearly two hours after his glider got entangled in live electricity wires during a flight from Bir-Billing. A 16-member disaster response team, a giant hydraulic crane and local authorities joined the operation, while Indian Air Force helicopters remained on standby. We look at how Indian rescuers pulled off the high-risk operation and why…
